bug_semantics: Git node clone TOCTOU (CWE-367): after repositoryPath is resolved with resolvePathAllowingMissingParents and checked via isFilePathBlocked, the node mkdir(dirname(resolvedRepositoryPath)) then git.clone(source, resolvedRepositoryPath). An authenticated workflow user can swap the validated dest for a symlink in that window so git writes a crafted repo into the community-node directory; n8n loads it as a custom JS node on restart (RCE). CVE.org CVE-2026-71539 is PUBLISHED (same patch set as GHSA-g3r5-9h93-4j2c / CVE-2026-65598).
flaw_origin: bd3aafce75ddb2e6f8fc196aea5fd76a0d774363 (fix(Git Node): Clone repositories into target path #30822) first wrote the check-then-mkdir-parent-then-clone-into-resolved-dest sequence. Parent 374e7ed0 cloned into '.' after mkdir of the dest itself and lacked resolvePathAllowingMissingParents.
evidence: git cat-file -e 374e7ed0b28b4d32432a704ba7cedddcf7cd0093:packages/nodes-base/nodes/Git/Git.node.ts succeeds. Parent Git.node.ts has helpers.resolvePath(repositoryPath), mkdir(resolvedRepositoryPath), git.clone(source, '.'). BIC Git.node.ts first adds resolvePathAllowingMissingParents, mkdir(dirname(resolvedRepositoryPath), {recursive:true}), baseDir=dirname(dest), git.clone(source, resolvedRepositoryPath). git log -1 --format='%an %ae %cn %ce' bd3aafce75 => Dawid Myslak dawid.myslak@gmail.com GitHub noreply@github.com; cat-file trailer Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>. Mainline fix 46c1a0e8f3 (chore: Bundle/2.x #33793) introduces cloneStagingPath / resolveStagingBaseForTarget / pinDirectory / rename; those strings are absent on parent 5c204364eb. Release backports: 225e2ff537 (n8n@2.30.1), 5e32b80df8 (n8n@2.29.8), 3508001337 (n8n@1.123.64).
reasoning: Vulnerability is the Git clone dest TOCTOU, not generic clone support (10303efdba cloned into '.') and not the later simple-git hooks restore (a8aa95551e). BIC is the first public commit that wrote clone-into-user-controlled resolved dest after a path check with a mkdir window. Cursor co-author is on that BIC commit object, so AI authored the vulnerable first-write. Fix clones into an n8n-controlled staging dir then pinDirectory/rename, closing the race. Advisory is published, not withdrawn.
